trainers.instruction: Oliver needs to measure out some sections of his garden before he can do any work. Which tool would it be best to use?

wrong.text: Oliver needs a measuring tool that can measure very long lengths to measure his garden.

instruction.text: Oliver wants to turn a section of his garden into a flowerbed which is 7 m long. Which section should Oliver dig? Drag the correct section to the tape measure and select 'Check'.
instruction.sound: Oliver wants to turn a section of his garden into a flowerbed which is 7 metres long. Which section should Oliver dig? Drag the correct section to the tape measure and select 'Check'.

instruction.text: How much is 7 m in centimetres?
instruction.sound: How much is 7 metres in centimetres?

atoms.b: 7 m is the same as <mat><gap>700</gap></mat> cm.
atoms.sound: 7 metres is the same as 700 cm.

instruction.text: The new flowerbed has to be 3.75 m away from the tree. Drag the section which shows the correct distance to the tape measure and select 'Check'.
instruction.sound: The new flowerbed has to be 3.75 metres away from the tree. Drag the section which shows the correct distance to the tape measure and select 'Check'.

instruction.text: How much is 3.75 m in centimetres?
instruction.sound: How much is 3.75 metres in centimetres?

atoms.b: 3.75 m is the same as <mat><gap>375</gap></mat> cm.
atoms.sound: 3.75 metres is the same as <mat><gap>375</gap></mat> cm.

trainers.instruction: Oliver needs to measure how deep into the ground he has to dig to plant the flowers. Which tool would it be best to use?

wrong.text: Oliver needs a measuring tool that can measure smaller lengths up to one metre to measure how deep to dig.

instruction.text: Drag the ruler to the soil to measure its depth and select 'Check'.
Oliver needs to dig 5.5 cm into the soil. Select the picture which shows the correct measurement on the ruler.
How much is 5.5 cm in millimetres?

atoms.b: 5.5 cm is the same as <mat><gap>55</gap></mat> mm.

atoms.text: Thanks for your help! The flowers look lovely.
atoms.sound: Thanks for your help! The flowers look lovely.
